difficulty_reason: Prove both the category of finite type O_X-modules and its quasi-coherent subcategory have a set of isomorphism classes for a ringed space (X, O_X): (2) follows from (1) as a full subcategory; for (1), any module F whose restriction to U_i is generated by at most r(i) sections is a quotient of H_{U, r} = oplus_{i in I} j_{i,!} O_{U_i}^{oplus r(i)}, and finite type means some open covering with index set I = X and some r : I -> N works; so it suffices that the choices of covering U, of r, and of quotients of H_{U, r} each form a set - the last because kernels of quotient maps H -> F are parametrized by subsets of the power set of prod_{U subset X open} H(U).
